title: Locally constant direct image of finitely many universal-homeomorphism components
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $W_i$ ($i\in\operatorname{Fin}(n)$) be pairwise disjoint open subschemes with union $X$. Suppose each $W_i\to X\to Y$ is a universal homeomorphism [def-weil-universal-homeomorphism]. If the underlying set sheaf of an abelian etale sheaf $E$ on $X$ is lisse, then the underlying set sheaf of $f_*E$ is locally constant [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves, def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. No finiteness of $f$ or Noetherian hypothesis is required; the number of components is finite and may be zero. No assertion of finite stalks is made in this intermediate theorem: the finite-morphism caller proves it separately from the existing finite-stalk formula.

source.place: ## Proof, finite-algebra calculation and final paragraph

proof.text: Pull the locally constant underlying set sheaf of E back to each component. Restriction to an etale cover member is identified with abelian inverse image by Etale.overSheafEquiv. The abelian/set inverse-image comparison and preservation of constant sheaves show that the pulled-back cover trivializes each component restriction. Finiteness of stalks is not needed.

For each universal-homeomorphism component map, descend a trivializing cover through the equivalence of etale categories. Base change of the map to each cover member is a universal homeomorphism. Fully faithful set inverse image reflects constancy via its constant-sheaf comparison. The restriction and composition isomorphisms identify the pulled-back restrictions. Finally the set inverse image of the component direct image is isomorphic to the original underlying component sheaf by the unit isomorphism of the sheaf equivalence. This proves local constancy of every component direct image.
Apply the disjoint-component assembly theorem to the given open cover and the local constancy of each component direct image just proved. It includes the empty family.
